name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.41-beta “Paris” (build 45): in step with the Mac 0.9.41.
• The Sidebar and Inspector buttons in the ribbon show sidebar icons, as on the Mac.
• Your licence is checked while LitArbi stays open (every 12 hours and after sleep). If a renewal payment fails, LitArbi tells you once a day, keeps working until the grace date and offers Update Payment Method…; the licence window shows “Payment failed”.
• If the subscription date has passed, the licence window first asks the server whether it was renewed before saying “expired”.
• Settings ▸ Citation: the citation font is chosen from a list of the fonts on this PC (including Office's fonts); Settings uses wider fields and remembers its window size.
